prompt: Create a photorealistic cinematic street portrait in a busy Japanese nightlife district at dusk. The frame is a wide 16:9 landscape image with the subject occupying the right half, tightly cropped so only the right side of her face, neck, shoulder, and hair are visible while the left half opens into a deep city street perspective. Show a young East Asian woman with dark brown shoulder-length slightly wind-tousled hair, soft natural makeup, closed or downcast eyes, relaxed lips, a delicate dangling teardrop earring, pale sunglasses resting on top of her head, and a dark leather jacket catching magenta neon reflections. She should look calm, introspective, and stylish, facing slightly downward and away from the camera. The background is a dense urban street lined with tall buildings and many vertical illuminated Japanese signs, including red, orange, green, white, and blue kanji/kana restaurant and entertainment signs; keep the signage authentic-looking but not the main focus. Add a large bright pink-red marquee or lightbox glow behind her head on the upper right, rows of small bulbs along a sign edge, and a cloudy gray evening sky visible above the street. Use shallow depth of field with the woman sharply detailed and the street signs slightly softened, realistic skin texture, natural lens perspective, rich neon color contrast, moody overcast ambient light, high dynamic range, and documentary fashion-photography realism. No watermark, no extra people in the foreground, no cartoon or illustration style.

promptZh: 创作一张在黄昏时分日本繁华夜生活街区的电影级写实街头肖像。画面采用 16:9 宽画幅，主体位于画面右侧，采用紧凑构图，仅露出她右侧的脸庞、颈部、肩膀和头发，左侧则延伸出深邃的城市街道视角。画面中的年轻 东亚裔 女性留着 深棕色 的齐肩发，发丝略显凌乱，妆容自然柔和，双眼微闭或低垂，双唇放松，佩戴着精致的垂坠泪滴状耳环，头顶架着一副浅色太阳镜，身穿的深色皮夹克映衬出洋红色霓虹灯光。她神情平静、内敛且时尚，面部略微朝下，背对镜头。背景是密集的城市街道，两侧高楼林立，挂满了许多垂直发光的日文招牌，包括红色、橙色、绿色、白色和蓝色的日文餐厅及娱乐场所招牌；招牌需保持真实感，但不要喧宾夺主。在画面右上角她头部后方添加一个巨大的亮粉红色灯箱光晕，招牌边缘排列着一排小灯泡，街道上方可见多云的灰色傍晚天空。采用浅景深效果，使人物细节清晰，街道招牌略显柔和，呈现真实的皮肤质感、自然的镜头透视、丰富的霓虹色彩对比、忧郁的阴天环境光、高动态范围，以及纪实时尚摄影的真实感。无水印，前景无其他路人，非卡通或插画风格。
